question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A thing which happens every two years
solution:
The correct answer is: **Biennial.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Biennial"** means something that happens every two years. (दो साल में एक बार होने वाला)

 
 
• **Example: **The biennial conference attracts delegates from all over the world.
 
 
 
• **"Biennial"** refers to events or occurrences that take place every two years. (दो साल में एक बार होने वाला)
 
 
• **Example: **The garden hosts a biennial flower show that draws huge crowds.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Century** (सदी): A period of one hundred years.

 
 
• **Example:** The 20th century saw significant technological advancements.
 
 
 
• **Annual** (वार्षिक): Occurring once every year.
 
 
• **Example: **The annual meeting is scheduled for next month.
 
 
 
• **Bi-monthly** (द्वैमासिक): Occurring twice a month or every two months.
 
 
• **Example:** The magazine is published bi-monthly, in January and July.
